First release of StockUp.

**Download `stockup.py` below**, put it in a folder of its own, and see the [README](https://github.com/kefirman9000/stockup#get-started) to get started.

- Review a whole batch, and mark editorial or creative in bulk
- Keeps captions that already start with a place and date
- Marks editorial automatically from a keyword, color label or pre-formatted caption
- Makes Shutterstock and Adobe spreadsheets, plus iStock creative and editorial folders
- Uploads to Shutterstock, Dreamstime, Alamy (and Adobe with SFTP), with a checkbox for each site
- Light and dark mode
- Update button for future versions
